notes: This manifest records the locally generated Phase 56L realized-outcome continuation package. Three named manufacturer rails are checked without substituting project fields for differently scoped outcomes. Suffolk County IDA reports 33 current Island Components FTEs against 25 before IDA status. Clinton County IDA records Monaghan's earlier $10 million project as construction complete in 2021 and reports 91 current FTEs against 68 before IDA status. Current Applications retains an exact non-closure because its NIST MEP case study is one intervention, not a repeat series. Research Watch 016, the three-record collection, two deepened pathways, two topics, the comparison protocol, and the six-file archive preserve scope, denominator, attribution, no-ranking, no-score, no-productivity, and no-causation rules. The release remains 0.2.0-dev and owner-only. Public access, DNS, public GitHub, custom-domain, and package changes are not authorized.
